claim_requested: We reduced AI or LLM spend by X%
evidence_required: Baseline period; post-change period; source bill or export; unchanged workload context; approved calculation method
pause_trigger: Missing source bill, disputed baseline, changed workload mix, or unapproved calculation
safe_note: Say candidate reduction areas were identified until measured and approved evidence exists.

evidence_required: GPU job owner; utilization record; queue impact; model-quality check; finance runway model; approved assumptions
pause_trigger: No finance owner, no ML quality review, or no approved runway model
safe_note: Say GPU usage and commitment decisions need validation before runway claims.

claim_requested: Cloud or AI savings are guaranteed
evidence_required: Contracted scope; approved risks; measured post-change evidence; legal/commercial approval
pause_trigger: Any unconditional guarantee language or missing approval
human_owner: Commercial owner + legal/procurement adviser where needed
safe_note: Do not promise savings; describe evidence review and approved cost-control actions.

claim_requested: We can publish a customer savings result
evidence_required: Customer consent; verified metric source; date range; attribution limits; publication approval
pause_trigger: No customer consent, unverifiable metric, or unclear attribution
safe_note: Use demo or simulated asset language until customer proof is approved.
